title: Capacity decision replay & operator notes — Fleet scaling inspector
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a Fleet Controls inspector view that replays operator scaling decisions and attaches contextual notes and telemetry so SREs and customers can understand why capacity changed. The feature will: (1) capture operator actions (manual scale, preset switches, policy overrides, emergency throttles), (2) replay the effect on throughput/latency/cost as an annotated timeline, (3) surface linked artifacts (PRs, runbooks, incident pages), and (4) provide a compact operator notes editor for post-mortem annotations. This ticket covers the product spec, observability contract, and rollout plan for the Console UI surface and handoff criteria for ENG and Design.
acceptance_criteria: Inspector view shows a time-ordered list of all scaling events for a selected fleet with timestamps, actor, and action type
Each event can be expanded to show a 30-minute telemetry window (throughput, p50/p95 latency, error rate) aligned to the action
Operator notes can be created or edited inline and are preserved in audit history with author and timestamp
Replay mode can simulate the fleet state at any event in the timeline and expose estimated token cost delta for the following 60 minutes
Backend exposes an API endpoint /api/fleets/:id/decisions that returns a compact trace for ENG integration and downstream export
Design review signed off (Figma link) and privacy review completed for any notes that may contain customer identifiers
notes: Design loop: requested denser timeline tick marks to improve scanability — Rafael to update Figma (done 2025-02-14)
Observability contract: ENG asked for 1s sampling for burst windows; product pushed back to 10s for index size constraints — agreed middle ground 5s (2025-02-18)
SLA mapping: associate each decision with the active throughput SLO and budget bucket so operator can see which budget was consumed
Privacy: redact user IDs in freeform operator notes by default; option to include raw IDs gated behind admin RBAC
